quick.definition: able to move fast; also ready to think or respond.
examples: Take a quick look at this.

quixotic.definition: unrealistic and overly idealistic, often in a way that ignores practical limits
examples: His quixotic plan failed in the real world.
She tried a quixotic rescue attempt.

quell.definition: to put an end to something, especially strong feelings or violence
examples: The police moved to quell the unrest.
She tried to quell her anger.

quatrain.definition: a stanza with four lines in poetry
examples: The poem uses quatrains to organize the story.
Each quatrain rhymes in the same pattern.
